# Elvtera

> Elvtera Business Solutions is a done-for-you B2B outbound partner. We watch for real buying signals (hiring, funding, new leaders, tech changes, expansion), reach out only to companies that fit a client's ideal customer profile, qualify every reply, and book qualified sales calls on the client's calendar. No ad spend. We also build business systems: websites, CRM pipelines, speed-to-lead automation and end-to-end business setups. Teams in India and the USA.

Key facts:

- Best fit: B2B companies with a proven offer and deals of roughly $5,000 or more.
- Target: 25+ qualified calls a month within 30 days, depending on offer and market.
- Clients approve every message before it is sent.
- A no-risk pilot lets clients see real prospects before committing.
- Contact: hello@elvtera.com

## Services

- [Signal-based outbound](https://elvtera.com/): The flagship service. Buying-signal research, outreach, reply qualification and calendar booking, done for you.
- [Outbound in detail](https://elvtera.com/solutions/client-acquisition): Intent sourcing examples, what is included, fit criteria and FAQs.
- [Business systems & websites](https://elvtera.com/solutions/business-systems): Conversion-focused websites, sales pipelines, speed-to-lead automation and follow-up.
- [End-to-end launch](https://elvtera.com/solutions/launch): A four-week path from idea to first paying clients for consulting and service founders.
- [All services](https://elvtera.com/solutions): The two services side by side, and how to choose.
